name: levelmeter
need: Show the live level of a microphone, with a peak and a word when it is too loud

--ds-levelmeter-height.description: a level meter's thickness at md, 2px more or less per size step

--ds-levelmeter-fill.description: the level and the peak mark

labExempt.DS.levelmeter.level: a pure function of a block of samples: no motion
labExempt.DS.levelmeter.decibels: a pure function of a level: no motion

physical..ds-levelmeter--segmented > .ds-levelmet: gradient direction: a meter fills left to right, as its scale from the start does
